info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Outstanding Client Balances API
Return the data for all OutstandingClientBalances

params.name: contact_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Contact. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a OutstandingClientBalance. The list will be filtered to include only the OutstandingClientBalance records with the matching property.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: last_paid_end_date
params.description: Filter OutstandingClientBalance records for those whose bills have been paid before the specified date

params.name: last_paid_start_date
params.description: Filter OutstandingClientBalance records for those whose bills have been paid after the specified date

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of OutstandingClientBalance records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: newest_bill_due_end_date
params.description: Filter OutstandingClientBalance records for the contact's newest bill due date before the specified date

params.name: newest_bill_due_start_date
params.description: Filter OutstandingClientBalance records for the contact's newest bill due date after the specified date

params.name: originating_attorney_id
params.description: Filters OutstandingClientBalance records to those with matters that have a matching originating attorney.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: responsible_attorney_id
params.description: Filter OutstandingClientBalance records to those with matters that have a matching responsible attorney

items.docs: Outlines the parameters, optional and required, used when requesting the data for all OutstandingClientBalances
